story.body: You set the bag on the cloth and took your part when John came to your name. The eight shillings for Edith is Thursday's payment out of the stock, and you only promised to remember it. You refused desert as a way of dividing the reward. The horse is how you mean to carry the part home, and you did not hire it in the room. George Bryan was in the room and did not speak.

story.body: You wrote the night's line in the form the book uses, and you ruled expected against had so the company's twenty pound stays under expected and does not go into your purse. The eight shillings is a memorandum of Thursday, not a payment. You struck the Queen's money off the tables and left the unsent letter. You did not state what the coffer holds.
